title: Broker reads on fixed refresh periods: 30 s for numbers, 45 s for positions (G-10-2)
reference_behaviour: Numbers are refreshed on a fixed 30 s timer and positions every 45 s, which spreads broker load by design (bundle-findings 6.1, architecture 4.1).
ours: NEW AC NEEDED: only a per-user limiter with bounded queues; no minimum period per user read, so a busy tab can spend the budget.
